source_clause: PVAL9.) For activation and deactivation, the user will have 10 attempts to type a 4 digit PIN before system cancels the deactivation. The user can try again in 30min.
leaf_desc_037: For both Valet Mode activation and deactivation, the system must allow a maximum of 10 incorrect 4-digit PIN entry attempts. Upon exactly the 10th consecutive incorrect attempt, the system must immediately cancel the current activation or deactivation process and initiate the lockout.
reasoning: 驗證目標：12.9（PVAL9）—— 錯誤 PIN 之次數上限為 10，第 10 次錯誤時系統取消該次停用程序。關鍵情境條件：第 9 次（仍可續試）與第 10 次（取消）構成邊界前後（§5.6），故取邊界值分析。為什麼這樣切：條文之 activation 與 deactivation 共用同一上限，本 TC 取 deactivation 一側，activation 一側屬 12.9 之 sibling leaf。刻意略過：30 分鐘後可再試之驗證需等待 30 分鐘，其觸發為時間到期而非第 10 次錯誤，已具名記於 remarks。

tcs.tc_title: Valet Mode deactivation cancelled on the tenth incorrect PIN
tcs.test_item: Valet Mode deactivation cancelled on the tenth incorrect PIN
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Valet Mode is active and a 4-digit PIN is set
2. No PIN lockout is in effect
tcs.input_test_data: PIN attempts: 9 incorrect attempts → 10th incorrect attempt
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Valet Mode deactivation screen and enter an incorrect 4-digit PIN nine times
2. Read the deactivation screen after the ninth attempt
3. Enter an incorrect 4-digit PIN a tenth time and check that the deactivation is cancelled
tcs.expected_result:
1. Each of the nine incorrect PIN entries is rejected
2. The deactivation screen still accepts a further PIN entry after the ninth attempt
3. The deactivation is cancelled on the tenth incorrect attempt and a further PIN entry is not accepted
tcs.priority_basis: Valet Mode 進出 —— R-U5 核心五類之一
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.remarks: 條文之「30 分鐘後可再試」需 30 分鐘等待，本 TC 只驗第 10 次即取消且當下不再受理，未驗 30 分鐘後之解鎖
